question: Where can I find a café that fall within 100 kilometers in the east direction of Senior Helpers, Largo, FL?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE amenity = 'cafe' AND ST_DWithin( geometry :: geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Senior Helpers%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Largo%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%FL%' LIMIT 1 ) :: geography, 100000 ) AND degrees( ST_Azimuth( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Senior Helpers%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Largo%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%FL%' LIMIT 1 ), geometry ) ) BETWEEN 67.5 AND 112.5;
